provenance.rawEvidence: runs/*.json and runs/streams/*.jsonl are written once per run and never edited; run-evals.js refuses to overwrite without --force.
provenance.reports: reports/, failures/, approval-study/ and plots/ are regenerated from the run records by harness/make-m2-report.js, harness/make-plots.js and harness/make-manifest.js.
provenance.policyMetric: policyCheck is the first-pass metric, kept for audit. policyCheckV2 is the refined metric added by harness/recompute-policy.js and applied identically to both modes.

reproduce: node harness/bridge-m1.js            # one per mode, own port and OUT_DIR
